messages.subject: BTS Group | Sustainable mobility, urban infrastructure and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear BTS Group Leadership Team,

BTS Group's position across mobility, infrastructure and sustainable urban development creates a strong fit with my experience in regulated operations, government engagement and ESG execution.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities cover government and regulatory relations, social performance, ESG, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

I bring experience managing complex public-sector interfaces, community commitments, sustainability governance and cross-functional action across technical and corporate teams. My recent work also includes stakeholder support around a large solar and battery-storage transition and carbon-data readiness based on operating evidence.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across Sustainability, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or stakeholder leadership. I have attached a BTS Group-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
